夺权（夺权（第22页）他不可能加入我们的阵营，我也不会让他们加入我的阵营。”尤莉娅凝视着画像，眼底闪过一丝冷冽。“来人。”数道黑影自地面阴影中悄然浮现。“小姐，您吩咐。”这些影卫都是老公爵留给尤里亚和阿尔杰的底蕴力量。“穿上黑袍，戴上恶鬼面具，去把剩下的几个贵族清剿掉。记住，只杀那几个重要人，剩下的人可杀可不杀，要留下证人看到你们出手的过程。”“遵命。”一众黑影领命，立刻消失在黑暗之中。尤里亚缓缓起身，迈步上楼，回到卧室。床榻之上，梅芙睡得安稳香甜，浑然不知外面发生了什么。尤莉娅轻轻抚摸梅芙的脸颊，一脸复杂。“梅芙，你的父亲野心太大，作恶也太多。如果没了他，黑曜公国一定会更加美好。”说着，尤里亚低头亲吻了下梅芙的额头，在床头下按了一下。一个开关便打开，露出了柜子里面的密令。尤莉娅取出密令，重新拿出一束安神草放在床头，转身快步走出卧室。大厅之内，13名禁卫团的御卡大师跪在她面前。尤里亚高举令牌，一脸冰冷。“现在罗威堡受到外敌入侵，罗威伯爵正在外面御敌，估计用不了多久就能大获全胜。我们的计划正在顺利进行。趁此机会，你们立刻前往前线战场，听从公爵大人的命令，帮助他拦杀那些将领，掌握军队的力量。事成之后，尔等都将受封爵位，共享荣光。”十三名御卡大师眼底燃起狂热，齐齐俯首。“属下愿为女爵大人效死，愿为公爵大人效死。”其余人也皆是齐声喊道：“愿为女爵大人效死，愿为公爵大人效死。”就在此时，侍卫匆匆赶来。“女爵大人，外面有骑士求见。”尤莉娅眼神一眯。挥了挥手，13名御卡大师立刻离开。没一会，一名骑士气喘吁吁冲入大殿，满脸焦灼。“女爵大人，伯爵有令，速速调兵驰援战场！”尤莉娅看了眼他手中的令牌，摇了摇头。“这调令是假的。”骑士连忙举起令牌，“怎么可能？这是公爵大人亲手给我调令，不信您看。”一个护卫接下令牌，五指骤然发力。在骑士惊愕的眼神中，将令牌捏成了一团铁疙瘩。骑士目瞪口呆，声音颤抖：“这调令可是用特殊材质打造的，哪怕是御卡宗师也不可能徒手将它捏成这个模样啊。”“你看，我就说是假的吧。”尤莉娅声音冷冽无比。那骑士还没反应过来，就看到一道寒光在眼前放大。“呃……”鲜血飞溅，骑士至死都满脸不可置信地盯着尤莉娅。“你……你……”尤莉娅垂眸俯视倒地的骑士，语气平静无比。“安心去吧。你的家族既往不咎，后世依旧可以效力公国。”尤莉娅心中通透。阿尔杰和她想要的，从不是清剿贪污腐败的贵族。他们要的，只是把不听话的清除掉，留下能效忠自己的。毕竟，管理公国还需要这些人。虽说他们不在乎背景出身，只看能力。可平民中有九成的都是文盲，用他们来管理公国不现实。想要安稳执掌偌大的黑曜公国，终究离不开世家贵族的辅佐。

Seizing power (Seizing power (page 22)) He cannot join our camp, and I will not let them join my camp." Yulia stared at the portrait, with a cold flash in her eyes. "Here comes someone." Several black figures quietly emerged from the shadows on the ground. "Miss, your order." These shadow guards are the power left by the old Duke to Yulia and Alger. "Put on the black robe, put on the evil ghost mask, and go and eliminate the remaining nobles. Remember, Kill only those important people, and you can kill the remaining people. You must leave witnesses to see the process of your action." "Yes." A group of shadows accepted the order and immediately disappeared into the darkness. Yuria slowly stood up and walked upstairs, returning to the bedroom. On the bed, Maeve slept peacefully and sweetly, unaware of what was happening outside. Yulia gently touched Maeve's cheek, with a complicated look on her face. "Maeve, your father is too ambitious and does too many evil things. Without him, the Obsidian Principality will definitely be better." As she spoke, Yuria lowered her head and kissed Maeve's forehead, and pressed it under the bedside. A switch opened, revealing the secret order in the cabinet. Yuria took out the secret order, took out a bunch of calming grass and placed it on the bedside, then turned and walked out of the bedroom quickly. In the hall, 13 card masters from the Imperial Guard knelt in front of her. Yuria held up the token with a cold look on his face. "Now Fort Lowe is in charge. When a foreign enemy invades, Count Luo Wei is out fighting the enemy. It won't take long for us to achieve victory. Our plan is going smoothly. Take this opportunity and go to the frontline battlefield immediately, follow the Duke's orders, help him kill those generals, and control the strength of the army. After this is accomplished, you will all be knighted and share the glory." The eyes of the thirteen card masters were ignited, and they all bowed their heads. "I am willing to die for the Baroness. I am willing to die for the Duke." The others all shouted in unison: "I am willing to die for the Duke." At this moment, the guards came in a hurry. "My Lord Baroness, there are knights outside asking to see you." Leah narrowed her eyes and waved, and the 13 card masters left immediately. After a while, a knight rushed into the hall panting, with a worried look on his face. "My Lady, the Count has ordered us to quickly mobilize troops to support the battlefield!" Ya looked at the token in his hand and shook her head. "This order is fake." The knight quickly raised the token, "How is it possible? This is the order given to me by the Duke himself. If you don't believe it, look at it." A guard took the order, and five The fingers suddenly exerted force. In the shocked eyes of the knight, the token was crushed into a ball of iron. The knight was stunned and his voice trembled: "This order is made of special materials, and even the master of card control cannot use it with his bare hands. It looks like this." "Look, I'll just say it's fake." Yulia's voice was extremely cold. Before the knight could react, he saw a cold light magnifying in front of his eyes. "Uh..." Blood spattered, and the knight stared at Yulia in disbelief until he died. "You...you..." Yulia lowered her eyes and looked down at the fallen knight, her tone was extremely calm. "Go with peace of mind. Your family will let go of the past, and you can still serve the principality in the future. "Yuliya has a clear mind. What Alger and she want is never to eliminate corrupt nobles. What they want is to get rid of the disobedient ones and keep those who can be loyal to them. After all, these people are still needed to manage the principality. . Although they don't care about background and background, they only care about ability, but 90% of the civilians are illiterate. It is unrealistic to use them to manage the huge Obsidian Principality. After all, they cannot do without the assistance of noble families.
